name: Swiss Railway Clock
author: ronnie
description: Hans Hilfiker's Swiss station clock in the bar, set to a location you are not in

barWidget.description: Analog Swiss station clock showing another location's time

schema.label: Location
schema.description: local follows this machine's own timezone (the default). Otherwise an IANA zone, such as Europe/Zurich or America/New_York.

schema.label: Location name
schema.description: Optional. Defaults to the timezone's own city name.

schema.label: Face size (% of bar height)
schema.description: How much of the bar's height the dial fills. Below about 55% the dial keeps only the quarter markers.

schema.label: Show the time beside the face
Time format
schema.description: Qt date/time format for the text beside the face, e.g. HH:mm or 'Zrh' HH:mm.

schema.label: Stop-to-go seconds
schema.description: The original movement: the second hand sweeps in 58.5s, then waits at 12 for the minute impulse.

schema.label: Dial
schema.description: classic is the white SBB dial; theme paints the face in your bar's own colors.

schema.label: Locations
schema.description: Comma-separated list for the panel and for cycling, e.g. Europe/Zurich=Zürich, Asia/Tokyo. Empty uses a built-in world list.
